text: Exact prospective binomial calculation for corrected 36-cell backbone: with 72 coverage/rejection comparisons and per-test one-sided alpha=0.001/72, inherited R=10000 gives only 29.4% TOST equivalence power at true 5% null rejection; R=15000 gives 83.3%, R=18000 gives 94.0%. Raw method/results retained at docs/verification/first-level-calibration/rate-budget.json and tools/calibration/rate_budget.py. Canonical draft raises planned rate R to 15000 subject to measured pilot cost and freeze; no confirmation run yet.
